eng-dave: Proposed quick mitigations:
- scale inference-pool +2 replicas
- toggle routing to stable models (disable canary weights)
- rollback proxy canary if needed
Commands I will run if approved:
```
kubectl scale deploy/inference-pool -n prod --replicas=20
# toggle routing (internal ops endpoint)
curl -X POST "https://ops.redwood.ai/routing/toggle?mode=stable" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

oncall-ryan: Go for scale and routing toggle. I'll coordinate rollback only if no improvement in 60s.
